-  Assert.equal(
-    scalars["tb.account.count"].rss,
-    NUM_RSS,

+  Assert.equal(rssValue, NUM_RSS, "RSS account number must be correct");

+  Assert.equal(ircValue, NUM_IRC, "IRC account number must be correct");
